# AI Study Buddy

> AI Study Buddy is an educational resource helping students explore AI tools and practical guides for studying, academic writing, research, presentations, and coding.

The website provides informational resources to help students use AI more effectively in their learning. Important factual claims generated by AI should be verified using reliable sources.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/): Overview of AI Study Buddy and its student resources.
- [AI Tools](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/ai-tools.html): AI tools relevant to student learning and academic tasks.
- [Study Tools](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/study-tools.html): Resources and tools to support studying and learning.
- [Writing Tools](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/writing-tools.html): AI tools for academic writing.
- [Research Tools](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/research-tools.html): AI tools for student research.
- [Presentation Tools](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/presentation-tools.html): AI tools for preparing presentations.
- [Coding Tools](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/coding-tools.html): AI tools to support coding and programming practice.
- [Blog](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/blog.html): Articles and guides about AI and student learning.
- [About](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/about.html): Information about the website and its purpose.
- [Contact](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/contact.html): Contact page.

## Blog Articles

- [AI Exam Revision](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/blog/ai-exam-revision.html): Guidance on using AI for exam revision.
- [AI Flashcards and Practice Quizzes](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/blog/ai-flashcards-and-practice-quizzes.html): Using AI to create flashcards and practice quizzes.
- [Better AI Prompts for Studying](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/blog/better-ai-prompts-for-studying.html): Improving prompts to get more useful AI study support.
- [Check AI Answers for Accuracy](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/blog/check-ai-answers-for-accuracy.html): Why and how to verify AI-generated factual claims.
- [Learn Coding with AI](https://project-595.github.io/ai-study-buddy/blog/learn-coding-with-ai.html): Using AI to support learning coding skills.
